name: @sos-2/implementation-orchestrator
description: SOS 2.0 Implementation Orchestrator (Work Order P13): the mission-to-plan-to-graph front half of the flagship greenfield journey. Mission intake as typed records (raw user mission -> formalized @sos-2/mission artifact, or a TYPED ASK where formalization cannot proceed — never a guess, never a silent default); architecture/capability planning produces an ImplementationPlan as typed, inspectable, content-addressed records (mission link, capability requirements, candidate structure, assurance constraints) that are DATA for the P6 task graph — never an imperative interpreter of their own; worker decomposition turns the plan into typed task-node specs with dependency edges, per-node capability requirements (the §3 harness vocabulary, consumed never re-defined) and per-node evaluation requirements (which P9 evaluators must pass before a node counts complete), validated for acyclicity and disjoint owned-path scopes. ASK is first-class at every stage (the P6 discipline): a PipelineAsk is a typed, content-addressed record. Determinism: no Date.now/Math.random/fetch/process.env/ambient timers/child_process in src — the clock is injected, identities are caller-supplied or content-derived.
